title: Host doors refuse a label that is a path, a job id that walks out of the jobs directory and a body that is not an object, and run a provision or teardown once for two simultaneous requests
steps: S1: Run apps/tracy-host/test/app.test.mjs: send two signed POST /_host/provision (then /_host/teardown) with the same jobKey at the same moment; send teardown and /_host/site webroot jobs with labels ../x, ../../etc, a/b, -rf, ., .. and a real label; GET /_host/jobs/..%2Fsecret and a real job id; send null, 7, "label" and [] as the JSON body to every door that reads one.
S2: Run packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/roots.test.mjs: call tracy_require_label and teardown.sh plus every webroot-*.sh with a path label and with a real one.
expect: S1: the script starts once for each pair and both answers name the same job; every path or flag label is 400 and the real label is 202; the traversal id is 404 and the real job reads; every non-object body is 400, never 500.
S2: tracy_require_label accepts the real label; every script exits 2 with 'refused label' on the path label before it builds a path.
evidence: QA suite: teardown accepted ../../etc and a/b with 202, GET /_host/jobs/..%2Fsecret answered 200 with a file outside the jobs dir, two provisions with one jobKey ran provision.sh twice, null bodies gave 500. The tracy-web half (comments/clear needs {mine:true}; %00/%FF site keys answer 400) is covered by apps/tracy-web/test/site-comments.test.mjs and site-key-encoding.test.mjs, which need TEST_DATABASE_URL and run in CI under ci:integration.
fence: teardown and /_host/site webroot jobs validate with SAFE_LABEL; tracy_require_label uses the same pattern; job ids must match the job-id shape in both the route and jobPath; a job key has one in-process claim until its job is written

tests: POST /_host/provision: two requests with the same jobKey at the same moment start provision.sh once
POST /_host/teardown: two requests with the same jobKey at the same moment start teardown.sh once
POST /_host/teardown and the webroot jobs of /_host/site refuse a label that is a path, and take a real one
GET /_host/jobs/:id refuses an id that is not a job id, and still reads a real one
a JSON body that is not an object is refused 400 at every door that reads one, never a 500
tracy_require_label takes a real label and exits 2 on one that is a path or a flag
every script the host doors hand a label to refuses one that is a path, before it builds a path
